name: Have you documented the risk assessment method used to perform a risk assessment?
conditionsText:
The documented method should cover the scope and approach to the assessment, including how threats, vulnerabilities, business impacts, likelihood and risk severity are identified and evaluated.
It should also define important terminology, assumptions and constraints. The guidance recommends documenting the assessment boundary and identifying what is in and out of scope.
requirementTitle: Have you documented the risk assessment method used to perform a risk assessment?
requirementDescription: Have you written down how you assess security risks so that someone can understand the process you followed and repeat it?
why:
Risk assessments involve judgement. Without a defined method, two people could assess exactly the same risk and reach very different conclusions.
Documenting the method makes the assessment:
- consistent
- repeatable
- understandable
- auditable
- easier to review and update.
tasks: Have you documented the risk assessment method used to perform a risk assessment?

actions.title: Have you documented the risk assessment method used to perform a risk assessment?
actions.description:
Document the risk assessment methodology, including:
• scope and boundaries
• terminology and definitions
• assumptions and constraints
• information/sources used
• how threats, vulnerabilities and impacts are assessed
• how likelihood and impact are scored
• how the overall risk rating is calculated
• how and when risks will be reviewed.
